signals.text: Revenue grew 16% a year over 3 years vs 21% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 21% vs revenue at 16%: operating leverage is showing.
Operating margin expanded 66 bps in 3 years (11.1% → 11.7%).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 118% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.

flags.text: Revenue grew 16% a year over 3 years vs 21% over 5: growth is slowing.

guidance.statement: The company expects growth of over 10% this year compared to last year.
guidance.quote: The broad expectation, which our Chairman also conveyed, is growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year.

guidance.statement: The company is looking at a INR14,000 crore capex for the full year FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, on the capex for FY 26-27, we are looking at a INR14,000 crores capex for the full year.

guidance.statement: The company has plans to increase production capacity to 4 million units per annum in the medium term.
guidance.quote: Besides, the company has put plans in place to increase the production capacity to 4 million units per annum in the medium term.

guidance.statement: The company aims to enable a network of over 100,000 charging points across India by 2030.
guidance.quote: our aim is to enable a network of over 1 lakh charging points across India by 2030, along with our dealers and charge point operators.

delivered.statement: Recorded highest ever annual sales of 2.42 million vehicles, including record 447,000 exports.
Achieved record net sales of over INR1.74 trillion in FY26, a 20.2% growth.
Achieved all-time high net profit of over INR144.4 billion in FY26.
Recorded highest ever quarterly sales of 676,209 units in Q4 FY26, up 11.8% year-on-year.
Achieved record net sales of about INR500.79 billion in Q4 FY26.
EBIT reached an all-time high of over INR44 billion in Q4 FY26, up 30.4% year-on-year.

calls.tone: confident on demand and capacity expansion, cautious on short-term geopolitical and commodity headwinds

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the impact of commodity and steel repricing on margins and whether pressures will persist in Q1.
Analysts pressed on the sustainability of the INR750 crores MTM hit on other income and potential for reversal.
Questions were raised regarding CAFE norms, powertrain mix, EV salience, and cost impact of flex-fuels.

guidance.statement: The company expects to enable volume growth of around 10% in FY 2026-27.
guidance.quote: While this capacity will take time to ramp up fully, it is expected to enable volume growth of around 10% in FY 2026-27.

guidance.statement: Installed capacity is expected to reach 2.9 million units by the end of FY 2026-27.
guidance.quote: As a result of the expansion projects, our installed capacity would reach 2.9 million units at the end of FY 2026-27

guidance.statement: Installed capacity is targeted to reach 3.65 million units at the end of FY 2030-31.
guidance.quote: and 3.65 million units at the end of FY 2030-31.

guidance.statement: Carbon footprint in production is targeted to reduce to 266,000 tonnes in FY 2030-31.
guidance.quote: Our carbon footprint in the production process would reduce from the present 615,000 tonnes to 266,000 tonnes in FY 2030-31.

guidance.statement: Renewable electricity consumption share is targeted to increase to 85% by FY 2030-31.
guidance.quote: Renewable electricity would increase from the present 23% to 85% by FY 2030-31.

guidance.statement: Solar energy use by the company is targeted to rise to 319 MWp by 2030-31.
guidance.quote: Solar energy use by the company would rise from 79 MWp at the end of FY 2025-26 to 319 MWp by 2030-31

guidance.statement: The company intends to use over 20 tonnes of biogas per day by FY 2030-31.
guidance.quote: By FY 2030-31 we intend to use over 20 tonnes of biogas per day.

guidance.statement: The company plans to introduce seven SUVs over the next five years.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, the Company plans to introduce seven SUVs over the next five years

delivered.statement: Revenue increased to over INR 1.8 lakh crore and profit after tax reached 144,454 million.
Annual sales reached a record 2.42 million vehicles, including highest-ever exports of 447,774 units.
Production volume reached a historic high of 2,347,792 units for the year.
Operating margin as a percentage of net sales moderated to 8.4% compared to 10.0% previously.
Achieved average fleet carbon emissions of 99.56 g CO2/km against a CAFE target of 110.93 g CO2/km.
Renewable sources accounted for nearly 22.8% of electricity consumed at manufacturing facilities.

calls.tone: Confident and optimistic about sustainable growth, capacity expansion, and multiple growth drivers.

business.summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited manufactures and sells passenger vehicles, light commercial vehicles, and automotive components, making money through vehicle sales, spares, and exports worldwide.

segments.name: SUV
segments.note: Major growth segment with multiple new model launches

segments.note: Core entry-level segment reviving after GST reduction

bull.point: Practically debt-free balance sheet with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.00.
Company expects volume growth of over 10% in FY27 supported by capacity expansion plans.

bear.point: Profit after tax dropped significantly to 2,466 crore in Sep 2026 compared to 3,349 crore in Sep 2025.
EBITDA margins compressed to single digits at 8.9% in Sep 2026 due to cost pressures.
Revenue growth has slowed with 3-year growth at 16% a year versus 21% over 5 years.
